asic/project/chip_project.ml.before_text:
(* University of Florida *)
(* Author: Bohdan Purtell *)
(* Module: "chip_project.ml" *)
(* ASIC project declaration for the current Tiny Tapeout observable top.

   Everything the Tiny Tapeout CMOS5L template fixes -- the wrapper ports, the LibreLane
   template settings and the reset and pad-gating idiom -- comes from Tt_cmos5l. What is
   left below is this chip: which core it wraps, how its pins are used, how fast it runs,
   and what it declares as its own source inputs. *)

open! Core
open! Hardcaml
open! Hardcaml_asic
open! Protemu_asic_rtl

let observable_pinout : Pinout.t =
  let descriptions = function
    | Pinout.Bank.Ui ->
      [ "P0 delay bit 0"
      ; "P0 delay bit 1"
      ; "P0 delay bit 2"
      ; "P0 delay bit 3"
      ; "P0 protocol pin 0 value"
      ; "P0 protocol pin 0 output enable"
      ; "P0 command valid"
      ; "Reserved"
      ]
    | Uo ->
      [ "Timer bit 0"
      ; "Timer bit 1"
      ; "Timer bit 2"
      ; "Timer bit 3"
      ; "Command ready"
      ; "Timer busy"
      ; "Command done pulse"
      ; "Command rejected pulse"
      ]
    | Uio -> List.init 8 ~f:(fun bit -> "Protocol pin " ^ Int.to_string bit)
  in
  List.concat_map [ Pinout.Bank.Ui; Uo; Uio ] ~f:(fun bank ->
    List.mapi (descriptions bank) ~f:(fun bit description ->
      { Pinout.bank; bit; description }))
;;

let memory_pinout : Pinout.t =
  let descriptions = function
    | Pinout.Bank.Ui ->
      List.init 8 ~f:(fun bit -> "Memory request address/length bit " ^ Int.to_string bit)
    | Uo ->
      [ "Status/response high bit 0"
      ; "Status/response high bit 1"
      ; "Status/response high bit 2"
      ; "Status/response high bit 3"
      ; "Status/response high bit 4"
      ; "Status/response high bit 5"
      ; "Status/response high bit 6"
      ; "Status/response high bit 7"
      ]
    | Uio ->
      [ "Reserved request input / response bit 0"
      ; "Reserved request input / response bit 1"
      ; "Reserved request input / response bit 2"
      ; "Reserved request input / response bit 3"
      ; "Reserved request input / response bit 4"
      ; "Memory request opcode bit 0 / response bit 5"
      ; "Memory request opcode bit 1 / response bit 6"
      ; "Memory request opcode bit 2 / response bit 7"
      ]
  in
  List.concat_map [ Pinout.Bank.Ui; Uo; Uio ] ~f:(fun bank ->
    List.mapi (descriptions bank) ~f:(fun bit description ->
      { Pinout.bank; bit; description }))
;;

let loader_pinout : Pinout.t =
  let descriptions = function
    | Pinout.Bank.Ui ->
      [ "Loader select, active low"
      ; "Loader host clock, idle low"
      ; "Loader host-to-device data"
      ; "Reserved"
      ; "Reserved"
      ; "Reserved"
      ; "Reserved"
      ; "Reserved"
      ]
    | Uo ->
      [ "Loader device-to-host data"
      ; "Loader response ready"
      ; "Reserved"
      ; "Reserved"
      ; "Reserved"
      ; "Reserved"
      ; "Reserved"
      ; "Reserved"
      ]
    | Uio -> List.init 8 ~f:(fun bit -> "Protocol pin " ^ Int.to_string bit)
  in
  List.concat_map [ Pinout.Bank.Ui; Uo; Uio ] ~f:(fun bank ->
    List.mapi (descriptions bank) ~f:(fun bit description ->
      { Pinout.bank; bit; description }))
;;

let project ?(overrides = Tt_cmos5l.overrides ()) kind =
  let design, name, title, description, pinout =
    match kind with
    | "observable" ->
      ( (module Observable_design : Project.Design)
      , "protemu_observable"
      , "Hardcaml protocol emulator"
      , "Programmable protocol emulator primitives generated by Hardcaml"
      , observable_pinout )
    | "memory" ->
      ( (module Memory_design : Project.Design)
      , "protemu_memory"
      , "Hardcaml protocol emulator memory consumer"
      , "P0.7 whole-word load and readback through registered flop memory"
      , memory_pinout )
    | "loader" ->
      ( (module Package_top : Project.Design)
      , "protemu_loader"
      , "Hardcaml protocol emulator with independent hardware loader"
      , "P3.5 fixed serial loader, integrated core, and registered program memory"
      , loader_pinout )
    | _ -> failwith "kind must be observable, memory, or loader"
  in
  Project.create
    ~name
    ~metadata:{ title; author = "Bohdan Purtell"; description }
    ~design
    ~target:
      { harness = Tiny_tapeout { tiles = T6x4 }; technology = Technology.ihp_sg13cmos5l }
    ~flow:(Flow.librelane ~overrides Hardening)
    ~clocks:[ { Clock.port = "clk"; period = Time_float.Span.of_sec (1. /. 48e6) } ]
    ~timing:
      { input_delays =
          List.map [ "ui_in"; "uio_in"; "ena"; "rst_n" ] ~f:(fun port ->
            { Hardcaml_asic.Timing.Delay.port
            ; minimum = Time_float.Span.of_ns 0.
            ; maximum = Time_float.Span.of_ns 1.
            })
      ; output_delays =
          List.map [ "uo_out"; "uio_out"; "uio_oe" ] ~f:(fun port ->
            { Hardcaml_asic.Timing.Delay.port
            ; minimum = Time_float.Span.of_ns 0.
            ; maximum = Time_float.Span.of_ns 2.
            })
      }
    ~pinout
    ~policy:(Resource_policy.create ~default:Flops [] |> Or_error.ok_exn)
    ()
;;

let input_paths kind =
  (match kind with
   | "observable" | "memory" | "loader" -> ()
   | _ -> failwith "kind must be observable, memory, or loader");

asic/tinytapeout/src/dune.before_text:
; p0_observable.v is generated but committed, because the Tiny Tapeout flow reads
; src/ directly. `dune runtest` fails when it is stale or when generation is not
; deterministic; `dune promote` refreshes it.

(rule
 (targets p0_observable.generated.v)
 (action
  (with-stdout-to
   %{null}
   (run
     %{exe:../../verif/observable/emit/generate.exe}
    -output
    %{targets}
    -module-name
    p0_observable))))

(rule
 (targets p0_observable.regenerated.v)
 (action
  (with-stdout-to
   %{null}
   (run
     %{exe:../../verif/observable/emit/generate.exe}
    -output
    %{targets}
    -module-name
    p0_observable))))

(rule
 (alias runtest)
 (action
  (diff p0_observable.v p0_observable.generated.v)))

(rule
 (alias runtest)
 (deps p0_observable.generated.v p0_observable.regenerated.v)
 (action
  (run cmp p0_observable.generated.v p0_observable.regenerated.v)))

; UART first-slice RTL for direct emitted-Verilog simulation. This is a separate
; block experiment, not yet the selected Tiny Tapeout project top.

(rule
 (target uart_tx.generated.v)
 (action
   (run %{exe:../../../ip/mechanisms/verif/emit/generate_p2.exe} uart_tx %{target})))

; P2.7's first working slice: the same frame taken through the pin bank and the timer.
; Same status as the block above - an emitted-RTL experiment, not the project top.

(rule
 (target uart_slice.generated.v)
 (action
   (run %{exe:../../../ip/mechanisms/verif/emit/generate_p2.exe} uart_slice %{target})))

; P3.1a contract-port consumer only. P3.1b supplies the registered RAM at the project top.

(rule
 (target protocol_core.generated.v)
 (action
   (run %{exe:../../../verif/system/emit/generate_core.exe} access %{target})))

; P3.2 executable composition. Program RAM remains an external latency-one port.

(rule
 (target executable_core.generated.v)
 (action
   (run %{exe:../../../verif/system/emit/generate_core.exe} executable %{target})))

; P3.3 core and mechanisms. Program RAM remains an external latency-one port.

(rule
 (target integrated_core.generated.v)
 (action
   (run %{exe:../../../verif/system/emit/generate_core.exe} integrated %{target})))

; P3.5 fixed serial loader plus integrated core. Program RAM remains an external
; latency-one port in this fixture; the adopted project supplies the registered resource.

(rule
 (target loader_core.generated.v)
 (action
   (run %{exe:../../../verif/system/emit/generate_core.exe} loader %{target})))

; P3.5 adopted wrapper simulation source, including the behavioral implementation of the
; context-registered program RAM. The temporary bundle remains inside Dune's sandbox.

(rule
 (targets
  loader_wrapper.simulation.generated.v
  loader_wrapper.synthesis.generated.v)
 (deps
   ../../../dune-project
   ../../../hardcaml_protemu.opam
   (source_tree ../../cli)
   (source_tree ../../project)
   (source_tree ../../rtl)
   (source_tree ../../../spec/isa)
   (source_tree ../../../ip/host_link/protocol)
   (source_tree ../../../ip/mechanisms/rtl)
   (source_tree ../../../ip/program_memory_controller/rtl)
   (source_tree ../../../ip/emulator_core/rtl)
   (source_tree ../../../ip/host_link/rtl)
   (source_tree ../../../ip/protemu_system/rtl)
  ../asic-dependencies.lock
  ../toolchain.lock)
 (action
  (progn
   (with-stdout-to
    %{null}
    (run
      %{exe:../../cli/asic_bundle.exe}
     loader
     loader_bundle
     %{workspace_root}))
   (run
    /bin/cp
    loader_bundle/simulation/tt_um_leemperor_hardcaml_protemu_loader.v
    loader_wrapper.simulation.generated.v)
   (run
    /bin/cp
    loader_bundle/src/tt_um_leemperor_hardcaml_protemu_loader.v
    loader_wrapper.synthesis.generated.v))))

; P3.1b verification tops. These are the same context-registered consumer/RAM
; circuits used by the Cyclesim backend suite, emitted separately by source role.

(rule
 (target program_memory_backend.simulation.generated.v)
 (action
  (run
    %{exe:../../../ip/program_memory_controller/verif/backend_integration/emit_program_memory_backend.exe}
   simulation
   %{target})))

(rule
 (target program_memory_backend.implementation.generated.v)
 (action
  (run
    %{exe:../../../ip/program_memory_controller/verif/backend_integration/emit_program_memory_backend.exe}
   implementation
   %{target})))
